lines.text: David defeated the Philistines and took Gath, and the Moabites became subject to him and brought tribute.
David defeated King Hadadezer of Zobah and captured a thousand chariots, but he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred.
David struck down twenty-two thousand Arameans of Damascus and placed an altar to the LORD in Aram of Damascus.

wrong_details.wrong: placed an altar to the LORD in Aram of Damascus
wrong_details.true: placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus

lines.text: David took bronze from Tibhath and Cun, which Absalom later used for the bronze Sea, and he dedicated the silver and gold to the LORD.
Abishai struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and David reigned over all Israel.
